notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel and Copy Artifact attached to an indestructible creature you control.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
description:
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Blazing Sunsteel and Copy Artifact trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to any target.
Resolve the Copy Artifact trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Copy Artifact
uses.cardState: as a copy of Blazing Sunsteel.
